description: This file defines a class HyperbolicChatConfig that extends an existing chat configuration class to adapt it for the Hyperbolic API, which is OpenAI-compatible. It includes methods for providing provider information and supported parameters, utilizing secret management for API credentials.

classes.name: HyperbolicChatConfig
classes.description: A configuration class for Hyperbolic's chat API, compatible with OpenAI's API standards, allowing customization of API base URL and parameters.

methods.name: Optional[str] custom_llm_provider(self)
methods.description: Property that returns the provider name 'hyperbolic' indicating the LLM provider.

methods.name: Tuple[Optional[str],Optional[str]] _get_openai_compatible_provider_info( self, api_base: Optional[str], api_key: Optional[str] )
methods.description: Returns the API base URL and API key, retrieving defaults from environment secrets if not provided.

methods.name: list get_supported_openai_params(self, model: str)
methods.description: Returns a list of supported OpenAI parameters for the Hyperbolic API, indicating compatibility with OpenAI's standard.
